---
title: Customize the Bub app
description: Extend the Bub application with tools, skills, plugins, and channels, or embed its application pipeline.
sidebar:
  order: 0
---

Start with the running Bub application and add the behavior your work needs. The builtin `BubAgent` extends `core.Agent`; the Framework supplies application orchestration, plugin hooks, and channel routing.

The guides below use the Bub application's configuration and extension points. To supply your own model and tools directly in a Python program, start with [Build your own agent](/docs/build/sdk/).

## Run the app

Follow the [application installation](/docs/getting-started/install/#app-install) and [run your first conversation](/docs/getting-started/first-turn/). Then [configure the model and workspace](/docs/operate/configure/) for your work.

## Choose what to add

| Your task | Start here |
| --- | --- |
| Add a callable function for the model | [Tools in the Bub app](/docs/build/app-tools/) |
| Give the model reusable instructions | [Write your first skill](/docs/getting-started/first-skill/), then [Skills](/docs/build/skills/) |
| Package an integration or replace an application hook | [Write your first plugin](/docs/getting-started/first-plugin/), then [Plugins](/docs/build/plugins/) and [Hooks](/docs/build/hooks/) |
| Accept messages through CLI, Telegram, or another adapter | [Channels](/docs/operate/channels/) |
| Embed the application's message pipeline or ship a distribution | [Embedding and distributions](/docs/build/distribution/) |
| Keep a Bub service running | [Deployment](/docs/operate/deploy/) |

Tools, conversation history, and agent events keep their [shared contracts](/docs/concepts/). The app adds its own defaults, including tool loading and code mode selection. [Tools in the Bub app](/docs/build/app-tools/) explains those policies; [the application turn pipeline](/docs/concepts/turn-pipeline/) explains how the Framework connects incoming messages to outgoing responses.

## Reuse an integration

- Browse [Bub Hub](https://hub.bub.build) for plugins, skills, and distributions.
- Follow the [integration guides](/docs/tutorials/) to connect a service or protocol.
- Check the [application reference](/docs/reference/#application) for signatures and defaults.
